title: AndroidAPS failed to get Juggluco readings without any errors
symptom: AndroidAPS had not had blood glucose readings for 481 minutes, while Juggluco was working correctly. Force closing and restarting AndroidAPS fixed the issue, suggesting it locked up somewhere.
cause: WorkManager stopped working (a Google library), possibly related to low system resources in the phone.
fix: Force closing AndroidAPS and restarting it resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: I fixed the issue by force closing AndroidAPS and restarting, so I suspect it locked up sonewhere.
